Everyone’s hyping #GTA6 – I’m still thinking about the Rockstar breach. 🎮

Billion-dollar budget, top devs. The entry point? Social engineering & a single Slack account.

The priciest firewall won’t save you if Zero Trust, IAM, and Least Privilege stop at internal tools. Hotwiring a car in Los Santos shouldn't be harder than stealing access rights. 😉
